section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one study (Study X) of 490 women who completed an internet-based self-report survey examining whether positive early emotional memories predict lower disordered eating via self-compassion and body appreciation. Path analysis indicated that self-compassion and body appreciation fully mediated the relation between early positive emotional memories and eating psychopathology, with the model accounting for 49% of variance.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Thus, this study aimed to explore a model..."; "The study's sample comprised 490 women who completed an Internet based survey comprising self-report measures of interest."; "Path analysis' results revealed that self-compassion and body appreciation fully mediated the impact of early positive emotional memories on eating psychopathology, when controlling the effect of age and Body Mass Index. The plausibility of the path model was confirmed which accounted for 49% of eating psychopathology's variance."
